icon.description: Icon shown with the category (a Lucide icon name). A report frozen before icons existed takes the category’s current one.

amountCents.description: Cents: spent for `expense` (positive when money went out), received for `income`.

previousAmountCents.description: Same figure for the month before.

targetCents.description: Monthly budget target (expense categories), null when none.

flow.description: Income, expenses and net of the month (transfers excluded).

netWorthCents.description: Net worth at the month end, in cents.

categories.description: Totals per category and kind (income, expense; transfers never), largest first, budgeted categories included even without spending.

oneOffs.description: Up to 5 one-off transactions, largest first.

closable.description: The month is over (before the current Europe/Paris month), so it can be closed.

report.description: The report as the data stands now.

closedReport.description: The report frozen when the month was closed.

changes.description: Figures that changed since the close (empty while the month is open).

notes.description: Notes of the month; empty or null clears them.

acknowledged.description: Steps marked as seen; replaces the current list.

notes.description: Notes saved with the close (kept as they are when absent).

dataUntil.description: Latest day with imported data (latest booked transaction or end of the latest committed import, every account), never after today in Europe/Paris. Null when nothing was imported. Transactions entered by hand do not count.

defaultMonth.description: Month shown when none is asked for: the current month when it has data, else the month the data stops in (YYYY-MM).

months.description: Months (YYYY-MM, oldest first) with at least one transaction, imported or entered by hand, up to the current month.
